aboutText: I study at Ankara Yıldırım Beyazıt University. Within the university's Machine Club, I work around UAV systems and competition teams, with an interest in connecting electronics, embedded software and mechanical design.
aboutText2: My interests include flight-control systems, STM32-based board design, PCB prototyping, GNSS signal integrity and software development. I value verifiable results, technical documentation and iterative prototyping.
